# Third-party code

Single-file libraries from [stb](https://github.com/nothings/stb) by Sean
Barrett, each under its choice of the MIT licence or the public domain (the
licence is at the end of each file). All three match stb commit
`2c980bb59875b0d32144a71867fbdebb2f77cd20`.

| File | Version | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `stb_image.h` | v2.30 | reformatted with the repository's clang-format |
| `stb_truetype.h` | v1.26 | reformatted with the repository's clang-format |
| `stb_image_write.h` | v1.16 | unchanged; only `tools/make_bitmap_font.c` uses it |
